enchantments.tooltip: Charisma +13: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Evocation Focus +8: +8 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.

Shield +13: While this item is equipped, you are partially protected by a field of magical force which can deflect enemy attacks. This item provides a +13 Shield bonus to Armor Class. It does not stack with an equipped shield.
Efficient Metamagic - Intensify II: The additional spell point cost for using the Intensify Metamagic feat is reduced by 2 SP.
Efficient Metamagic - Maximize II: The additional spell point cost for using the Maximize Metamagic feat is reduced by 4 SP.
